node.statement: Parametric halo collapse: for an exact signed idempotent P with 0 < delta(P) <= 1/4, nonempty visible set W(P), hidden top vertex v of height H, and any halo width a > 0, writing sigma_a for the positive coefficient mass v places on rows at ell-1 distance > a*tau from conv W (tau = sqrt(delta)), sigma for the invisible mass, and nu_v for the row negative mass, one has H*(1 - sigma_a) <= (sigma - sigma_a)*a*tau + nu_v*(2 + 4*delta).
